title: Everspin Technologies expands on-shore MRAM manufacturing capacity
summary: Everspin Technologies has expanded its onshore MRAM manufacturing capacity through a 10-year (extendable) agreement with Microchip Technology, strengthening long-term semiconductor supply chain resilience. The partnership establishes a copy-exact MRAM production line at Microchip’s Oregon fab, allowing Everspin to scale output while retaining full intellectual property control and continuing operations at its Chandler, Arizona facility.Read more on this partnership: https://siliconsemiconductor.net/article/123971/Everspin_Technologies_expands_on-shore_MRAM_manufacturing_capacity
body_markdown:
Everspin Technologies has expanded its onshore MRAM manufacturing capacity through a 10-year (extendable) agreement with Microchip Technology, strengthening long-term semiconductor supply chain resilience. The partnership establishes a copy-exact MRAM production line at Microchip’s Oregon fab, allowing Everspin to scale output while retaining full intellectual property control and continuing operations at its Chandler, Arizona facility.


Read more on this partnership: https://siliconsemiconductor.net/article/123971/Everspin_Technologies_expands_on-shore_MRAM_manufacturing_capacity
